view: The one-screen overview added in the round-4 revision: masthead with progress tracker (0 of 55, per-grade counts, watch-list note), the full filter bar at work (search, grade, category, type, watch-only, hide-earned, spoiler shield, export and import, 'Showing 55 of 55 trophies'), then one guide open whole — Paradise Lost with its official wording, full guide naming PowerPyx and GTABase in the text, all four steps and its highlighted source line — beside the head of the checklist (12 rows with checkboxes and grade pills, the other 43 summarised) and the watch list naming both verify-first trophies.
The six-stop roadmap to the platinum, scrolled into view: each stop's method text and the list of trophies it clears.

The first guide cards: official name, description and grade, the full original guide text, numbered steps, field tip and — since the round-4 revision — the source line on each card set in a highlighted box so the citation stays readable at judge size.

The watch-list filter at work: the two remaining verify-first trophies with WATCH flags — Positive Mental Attitude with its full guide to the possibly missable Chapter 1 meditation, and the spoiler shield hiding the still-unconfirmed Bad Luck, I Guess until it is earned or revealed.
